name: One Vassar
acresNote: Planning Commission packet for the Feb 20, 2020 approval (case 2012.1384): twelve lots on Assessor's Block 3763 with a lot area of about 102,694 sq ft (2.36 acres). One of them, lot 112, has since been retired and split; the parcels drawn come to about 2.2 acres.

program.notes: As approved on Feb 20, 2020: three buildings of about 1.5 million gross sq ft in all. 400 2nd Street (Building 1) is a 27-story office building, 350 ft to the roof (385 ft with rooftop equipment), with about 430,000 sq ft of new office over an 85-ft podium. At 645 Harrison Street (Building 2) the existing four-story, 55-ft building is kept, with 63,115 sq ft of its office and 42,013 sq ft of PDR space, and a 15-story hotel addition with 468 rooms (221,965 sq ft) rises to 200 ft. 657 Harrison Street (Building 3) is a 35-story residential building, 350 ft to the roof (385 ft), with up to 489 homes and a 14,000 sq ft child care center over an 85-ft podium. The office figure (493,115 sq ft) counts the new and the retained office. Also 37,551 sq ft of retail, about 14,655 sq ft of public open space including a new Hawthorne Street Plaza between the buildings, an extension of Perry Street to 2nd Street, and 322 underground parking spaces. Affordable housing is met by a fee at 33%, 110% of the otherwise required 30%; no affordable homes are built on site.

developer: One Vassar (the property owner and applicant named in the 2020 approval and CEQA notice)
publicPartners: San Francisco Department of Building Inspection
Caltrans (land for the Perry Street extension)
stageNote: The Planning Commission approved the project on Feb 20, 2020. DBI approved the site permits for the office building (June 23, 2023) and the residential building (Nov 13, 2023) but has issued none of the project's site or demolition permits, so construction hasn't started.

timeline.event: SF Planning opens case 2012.1384 for the redevelopment of 400 2nd Street and its neighbors on Harrison Street.
Planning Commission certifies the Central SoMa Plan EIR (Motion 20182); the plan names 2nd and Harrison a key development site.
Site permit applications for the three buildings are filed with DBI.
Planning Commission holds an informational hearing on the project.
Planning Department finds the project covered by the Central SoMa Plan EIR (community plan evaluation).

Planning Commission approves the project: Large Project Authorization (Motion 20665), 430,000 sq ft of office allocation (Motion 20666) and the hotel (Motion 20667); the Zoning Administrator indicates intent to grant the variances.
The City files a notice of exemption for the project with the State (SCH 2020050176).
DBI approves the site permit for the 27-story office building at 400 2nd Street (permit 201912068928); it has not been issued.
DBI approves the site permit for the 35-story residential building at 657 Harrison Street (permit 201912068933); it has not been issued.
Applications to demolish the buildings at 653, 657 and 665 Harrison Street are filed with DBI (an application for 400 2nd Street followed in April 2023); none has been issued.

nextMilestone: DBI issuing the site and demolition permits; none was issued as of Oct 19, 2026.
summary: Three buildings at 2nd and Harrison streets: a 350-ft office tower at 400 2nd Street, a 200-ft, 468-room hotel addition on the historic 645 Harrison Street building, and a 350-ft residential tower with 489 homes, about 1.5 million sq ft in all. Approved in 2020; DBI has approved two of its site permits but has issued none.
